Class Friendship

java.lang.Object
domain.Entity<Tuple<Long,Long>>
domain.Friendship
public class Friendship extends Entity<Tuple<Long,Long>>
Represents a friendship between two users. The friendship is identified by the normalized pair of user IDs and stores the date and time when the friendship was created.
